name: Cartwheel
description: Spoked wheels on a fixed axle — rim, hub bar and cross-spoke, all struck to the same measure.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 92%; height: 92%; margin: 4%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 50%; border: calc(16px / @Y) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 44%; top: 4%; width: 12%; height: 92%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 44%; width: 92%; height: 12%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
